title: Spatial Omics Explorer dataset collection
description: A list of datasets to browse together, opened with collection= in the viewer's address. Each entry is anything dataset= opens: a dataset folder, file or store, or a dataset manifest. Relative paths resolve against the collection's folder, or against `root` when set.

name.description: Display name, shown in the collection bar.

root.description: Base for relative dataset paths instead of the collection's folder. Relative to the collection, or an http(s) URL.

datasets.description: The datasets, in the order the collection bar lists them. The first one opens first.

path.description: A path relative to the collection's folder (or `root`), or an http(s) URL.

dataset.description: What dataset= opens: a dataset folder, file or store, a dataset manifest, or one section of an AnnData table (`table.h5ad#obs.section=s01`). Each dataset appears once.

name.description: Label in the collection bar, and in the top bar when the dataset has no manifest name. Without it, the bar shows the last part of the path.

group.description: Group label, such as a time point or donor. The bar lists groups in the order they first appear.

image.description: An image to show under an AnnData dataset's cells: OME-Zarr, OME-TIFF, TIFF, QPTIFF, SVS or NDPI. Resolved like `dataset`. Other datasets keep their own image.

coordinates.description: What the dataset's cell coordinates are in: micrometres, or the image's full-resolution pixels, which are scaled to micrometres by the image's pixel size. Needs `image`.

labels.description: A segmentation drawn as cell boundaries: a label mask covering `image` (OME-Zarr or TIFF), where label N outlines the cell whose label value is N, or polygons (Parquet, including Xenium's cell_boundaries.parquet, GeoJSON or WKT), each outlining the cell its ID names (see `labelColumn`). The format comes from the name unless `labelsFormat` sets it; a name that tells none is read as OME-Zarr. Resolved like `dataset`. Needs `image`.

labelsFormat.description: The format of `labels` when its name does not tell it. Needs `labels`.

labelsCoordinates.description: What the polygon coordinates of `labels` are in: micrometres, as Xenium writes them, or the image's full-resolution pixels. Defaults to `coordinates`. Label masks are placed over the image whatever this says. Needs `labels`.

labelColumn.description: The obs column holding each cell's label value (whole numbers, or strings of them), or, for polygons, its polygon's ID. Without it, a mask's labels match the table's SpatialData instance key, else the shortest obs column named like "label", whichever holds whole numbers for most cells; else the obs names. Polygons match whichever of the obs names, the instance key and the obs columns named like labels or IDs (such as `cell_id`) holds the most polygon IDs. Needs `labels`.

coordinateSystem.description: A name for registered coordinates, such as one patient's serial sections. Datasets with the same name put a point at the same place in each, so they can be shown side by side with one view, and switching between them keeps the view.

z.description: The section's depth in its coordinate system, in the same units as its cells (micrometres), such as its distance from the first section cut. Sections of a coordinate system with a `z` can be stacked in 3D. Give every section of a coordinate system a `z`, or none. Needs `coordinateSystem`.

url.description: OME-TIFF, TIFF, QPTIFF, SVS or OME-Zarr image, resolved like `dataset`. Each named only once.

customImages.description: Images opened as custom image layers over the dataset's own image, in order, for any platform, in place of those the dataset's manifest lists (an empty list opens none). Each is placed by its own pixel size from the dataset's origin, so it must already be registered to the dataset. A link that lists custom image layers opens those instead.

repository.description: Repository or host, such as BioImage Archive.

accession.description: Accession or identifier in that repository.

license.description: Data licence, such as CC BY 4.0.

defaults.description: Display settings for the first dataset opened from the collection, except channelSettings, which every dataset's image takes. A shared link's own values take precedence; after that, switching datasets keeps the current genes and colouring.

genes.description: Genes to select. Names must match the gene panel exactly.

colorCellsBy.description: The Cell color control. Without it, genes colour cells by gene expression.

geneRange.description: The Gene scale range, [min, max]. null leaves that end on Auto (0 at the bottom, the 99th percentile of the scores above 0 at the top); max must be above min. max may also be a percentile of each dataset's scores above 0, from "p1" to "p100", such as "p95". Kept when the next dataset sets no range.

cellPointScale.description: The Cell point size multiplier, from 0.5 to 32; other values snap to the nearest slider step.

contrast.description: The contrast window, [min, max], in the image's pixel values (0 to 65535 for 16-bit). max must be above min.

channelSettings.description: Image channel colours and contrast windows, by channel name (case-insensitive) or ID. A channel given a contrast window is not auto-contrasted.
